why_hard: Clean control for non-ischemic cardiomyopathy: GDMT is clearly over 3 months and every fact is plainly stated.

pages.title: Heart failure clinic note
lines: Background: admitted 12/28/2025 w/ new HF. Cath 12/30/2025: normal coronary arteries. Dx dilated non-ischemic cardiomyopathy. GDMT started 01/06/2026 and titrated to target/tolerated doses by 04/2026.
Now: DOE walking half a block or one flight. No rest symptoms. No syncope.
CMR 09/18/2026: LVEF 29% despite ~9 months of GDMT.
Plan: primary prevention ICD referral; SDM.
